title: Numeric Ranges
question: Is the numeric range constraint present at each capture boundary?
notes: Measured as present at every declared framework capture boundary. Where a framework builds its schema from a model class, optional parameters are wrapped, but the constraint remains inside the wrapper.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: preserved inside the `anyOf` wrapper emitted for optional fields, so the constraint sits one level down rather than being lost.

verdict.headline: Present at all five declared capture boundaries.
verdict.detail: The constraint remains intact in every captured tool definition.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Without bounds a downstream model may request out-of-range values.
reproduce: uv run mcp-mirror scan "uv run python fixtures/tricky_server.py" --runner managed --frameworks crewai,langchain,openai_agents,pydantic_ai --spec-version 2025-11-25 --job J2
